title: Crafted 64
description: A new 8x8 look for Minecraft using 64 colors and 64 pixels
body:
# Crafted 64
**Crafted 64** is a resource pack that makes many of the game's textures into 8x8 textures that only use 64 pixels! Keep in mind that **this pack is a work-in-progress**, so not everything is textured yet.

This pack's textures were created using [Aseprite](https://www.aseprite.org) with the 64 colors provided by the [Resurrect 64 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/resurrect-64) on Lospec, created by [Kerrie Lake](https://lospec.com/kerrielake). Huge thanks to her for the amazing palette! This adds a simple charm to the game's look.

The goal of this pack is to have every block, item and mob in vanilla Minecraft be textured, starting with the blocks. Every update has a changelog detailing everything that has been added or changed!
